statement: ∀ (C : Set (V n)) (a b : ℝ), IsCompact C → (∀ x, x ∉ C → ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc a b, u (x,r) = q) → ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → ∀ x, x ∉ C → ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo a b, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u (x,r) = 0
proof:
intro C a b hC hu k hk x hx r hr
have hopen : IsOpen (Cᶜ ×ˢ Set.Ioo a b) := hC.isClosed.isOpen_compl.prod isOpen_Ioo
have hmem : (x,r) ∈ Cᶜ ×ˢ Set.Ioo a b := ⟨hx, hr⟩
have heq : u =ᶠ[𝓝 (x,r)] (fun _ : V n × ℝ => q) := by
  filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds hmem] with p hp
  exact hu p.1 hp.1 p.2 ⟨hp.2.1.le, hp.2.2.le⟩
have hd := (heq.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds
rw [hd, iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (Nat.ne_of_gt hk) q]
rfl
